Each panel generated independently through the committed T-0104 workflow (see `panels` below for the exact per-panel prompt/seed) rather than as one combined prompt -- a single four-class prompt was tried first (seeds 21140, 21150, 21160) and each attempt lost the four distinct prop classes to the soviet_brutalism_style_v1 LoRA's strong whole-building bias (see `_generator_note`); per-panel generation lets each class's own prompt dominate its own sampling run. The transformer-housings + breaker-panel quadrant kept losing its own two distinct sub-objects to the same bias even after per-class splitting, so that quadrant is itself split into three independent sub-generations (`panels[1].sub_panels`: two transformer housing units, one breaker panel) placed side by side, every one of them at the sheet's own 0.70 style LoRA weight -- no sub-generation runs with the LoRA disabled or reduced.
